title: Joe Firmage's Inter NASA group
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Joe Firmage's Inter NASA group, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I believe he started this group called Inter NASA, which was based on the Academy of Arts and Sciences.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he believes a man named Joe Firmage started a group called Inter NASA. Michels says it was modelled on the Academy of Arts and Sciences, though he gives no date or place.
